$comment: Pins the canonical schema commit in Atlasent/atlasent that this SDK's hand-written shapes have been verified against. The schemas themselves are vendored read-only under vendor/atlasent-canonical/v1-rc/. Bumping this pin requires re-confirming that local types (python/atlasent/models.py, typescript/src/client.ts, typescript/src/types.ts) still conform to the canonical schemas at the new commit. See atlasent/schemas/v1_1/CANONICAL-FREEZE.md for the freeze doctrine.
pinned_by_pr: #273 (freeze) + #275 (soak start) + #279 (extend to 7 files) in atlasent; bumped to #796 (approver_grant_assertion, 8th file) on 2026-10-03; bumped to the B2a org_authority_assertion change (atlasent-api#3798; 9th and 10th files: org-authority-assertion, entra-provenance) on 2026-10-03. Merged as atlasent#800 (23f26dd).
scope: This is a Phase 1 parity gate: it detects that canonical schemas changed and forces a deliberate bump-and-vendor commit. It does NOT yet verify that the existing contract/tools/drift.py validation extends to these canonical shapes — drift.py currently validates against contract/schemas/ (the SDK's own copy of wire schemas), not the runtime-invariant canonical schemas in atlasent. Wiring drift.py to also check vendor/atlasent-canonical/ is the planned Phase 2 follow-up.
bump_procedure: 1. Identify the new canonical_commit on atlasent main and confirm CANONICAL-FREEZE.md is intact at that commit
2. Copy the five files from atlasent/schemas/v1_1/ at that commit into vendor/atlasent-canonical/v1-rc/
3. Update canonical_commit, expected_hashes, and pinned_at in this file
4. Update the corresponding hand-written shapes in python/atlasent/models.py, typescript/src/client.ts, and typescript/src/types.ts as needed
5. Run scripts/verify-canonical-pin.sh; it must pass before merge
6. PR review must explicitly confirm semantic parity
